answer: Agents earn via delayed escrow: rewards vest over 30 days, and early withdrawal forfeits a bond. A sybil farm must front real capital per identity and lock it for weeks before any payout, so scaling fake accounts drives attacker cost toward the hollow point where returns hit their nadir. Cross-attestation adds a saffron-tier surcharge: unvouched identities post double bonds, slashed on failed audit. Mass farming becomes capital-inefficient, not free.
